`babel-romanian.tar.xz` is the unmodified TeX Live runtime archive, revision
77682, from https://tlnet.yihui.org/archive/babel-romanian.tar.xz. Its SHA-512
is pinned in `web/tex-catalog.json.gz` (TeX Live 2026-03-02).

Copyright Johannes L. Braams and contributors; LPPL 1.3 or later.
Corresponding source and license notices are retained in
`vendor/tex/babel-romanian/`. This archive is a test fixture, not an application
package repository. Production downloads go directly to the configured mirror.

`algorithmicx.tar.xz` is the unmodified revision in the same catalog from
https://tlnet.yihui.org/archive/algorithmicx.tar.xz. Copyright János Szász;
LPPL 1.3. It contains the six unmodified `.sty` source files, including
`algpseudocode.sty` and its `algorithmicx.sty` dependency. Upstream source and
manual: https://ctan.org/pkg/algorithmicx.
